<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Storage in PostgreSQL: each module's queries, written for sqlc from the model and generated into internal/&lt;module>/sqlgen, and each entity's use cases (create, read, list, update, delete, and adding to and removing from many-to-many relations) as methods of its module. With testcontainers, each use case gets tests against a real Postgres.

```esquadro
blueprint store
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Hooks

- `post-gen` sqlc, writes `internal/*/sqlgen/**`
